billsHint.included: Part of the monthly price, with no ceiling. You carry whatever the meters say.
billsHint.capped: Part of the monthly price up to the cap — anything over it we invoice to the tenant.
billsHint.excluded: We invoice the tenant for the utilities.

pricing.depositHint: Held by Ebrostay and returned after check-out.
pricing.minStayNote: The longest is up to 12 months — the platform maximum.

breakdown.note: Estimate at 30 days. Our commission is 15% of the rent, capped at 30 days' rent, and charged once at the start of a stay — later payouts are rent in full. Utilities are metered and settled after move-out. We agree the final price with the tenant; you never negotiate.

pricing.saveNote: Price changes apply to new requests only — confirmed stays keep the price they were agreed at. Saving keeps your home in search.

cleaningHint.platform: We inspect, read the meters and deep-clean between stays, and charge the tenant for it. Nothing to organise, nothing in your payout.
cleaningHint.host: You organise the clean and the inspection; we charge the tenant your fee at move-in and pass it to you in full.

pricing.turnoverHint: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} shut after every stay for the inspection, the meter readings and the deep clean. Guests cannot book into them.

availability.saveNote: Calendar changes go straight through and keep your home in search. Only edits to the listing itself go back to review.
availability.conflict: That span crosses dates that are already closed. Pick a range that clears them.
availability.browseHint: Two months at a time — the band above marks where you are.

billing.label: BILLING & PAYOUTS
billing.figure: {count, plural, one {# PAYOUT AHEAD} other {# PAYOUTS AHEAD}}
billing.moneyPath: The tenant pays Ebrostay on the 1st. We take our commission and pay you on the 5th — you never invoice or chase anyone.
billing.empty: Nothing scheduled. Payouts appear here as soon as a stay is confirmed.
billing.totalLabel: {count, plural, one {# payout ahead} other {# payouts ahead}}

billing.footnote: Payouts leave on the 5th for the month in progress, once the tenant's payment has cleared — if a payment is late your payout moves with it, and we tell you the same day. Our commission is 15% of the rent, capped at 30 days' rent, charged once at the start of a stay. These are scheduled amounts, not settled payments: payout records and your account arrive with the payments system.

address.cadastreInfoWhat: The identifier the Catastro gives every property in Spain: 20 letters and digits. The four before the last two pick out the individual home inside the building.
address.cadastreInfoWhere: It is printed on your IBI receipt, which is the quickest place to look. It is also on the deed, or you can search for it by address at the Catastro's electronic office.
address.cadastreInfoWhy: "Calle Movera 7" covers several flats; the cadastral reference covers only yours. It lets the contract name the home without ambiguity, and lets us check that the ownership paperwork belongs to this listing.
address.cadastreInfoLink: Look it up at the Catastro

typeCompare.title: Display typeface comparison
typeCompare.intro: The same headline, wordmark and card in four typefaces. Familjen Grotesk is the current face (chosen 2026-07-22 in this comparison); Bricolage was v1's display face. Body stays Onest throughout.

note.bricolage: The previous face (also v1's display): warm grotesque with quirky cuts.
note.familjen: The current face: warm grotesque with a calm, rounded skeleton — v1's tone, its own form.
note.schibsted: Sharper and more editorial — the 'serious paper' voice; hardens the whole.
note.fraunces: The wildcard: a warm display serif — a different genre entirely; more classic hospitality, less platform.

design.title: Design system
design.intro: The Ebrostay v2 style book: “the calm ledger of a stay”. River = open, green = yours, ink = occupied.
design.calendarHint: Booked days are crossed with a diagonal line; the month band is only the summary — day-level truth lives here.
design.dialogBody: The booking request is sent by email. The team reviews and confirms it manually.
design.displaySample: One flat, one contract, calm months by the Ebro
design.bodySample: Every home comes furnished, verified and move-in ready. All amounts shown are estimates; the contract sets the final price.
design.datePickersHint: A popover field (move in / move out) that opens the themed calendar — the candidate to replace the native date-input pair. Compare it with the native one below.
design.dpSplitHint: Two calendars in one popover: left = move in, right = move out. Doesn't close on pick, only on outside click.
design.budgetHint: Today's number field says nothing about the market: you can't tell whether €1,200 is generous or hopeless. Three ways to show the distribution, on sample data (26 homes).
design.budgetAWhy: A histogram by price step, median marked. Shows the shape of the market; past your ceiling it's closed water — the same diagonal hatch as a booked day. With few homes the columns give way to one mark per home.
design.budgetBWhy: Cumulative: how many homes a ceiling opens. The flat stretches are the finding — money spent there buys nothing.
design.budgetCWhy: No dragging: three ceilings drawn from the prices themselves (p30 / p55 / p80), each with its count. Holds up on a phone and on a thin catalogue.
design.budgetCompareHint: The same prices drawn both ways, at the same ceiling. Bucketing doesn't break on a small catalogue — it still draws. It just stops saying anything: bar height can only be 1 or 2, the bucket width implies an approximate price when we know the exact one, and the number of buckets is decided by the gap between cheapest and dearest, not by how many homes there are.
